name: Moonglass Hermitage
introDiscord: A quiet moonglass hermitage rests beneath dark water, its mirrored halls once used by pilgrims seeking answers from the Astral Tide. Your reflection enters a moment after you do.
introTwitch: A quiet moonglass hermitage rests beneath dark water, its mirrored halls once used by pilgrims seeking answers from the Astral Tide. Your reflection enters a moment after you do.

pilgrim-mirror.prompt: A mirrorlike landing reflects three corridors perfectly. Your reflection studies them too. Then it briefly looks toward a fourth corridor that doesn't exist.

left.message: A Fae offering vessel appears in a reflection but not in the room itself. You reach behind the mirror on principle and somehow find the real vessel containing Star Candies.

right.message: A figure in the glass copies your movements until you notice one detail: it has a shell. A Moonglass Hermit steps out from behind the reflection and blocks the path.

forward.message: Shizuki's little infirmary contains a Moonglass elixir and a cup positioned suspiciously far away. Her note reads: "Sip carefully. The cup has opinions. It preferred Glimmer."
forward.fullHpMessage: The Moonglass elixir remains beside its opinionated cup. You are already at full health, so neither gets a vote today.

silent-cloister.prompt: Silent cells surround a glass cloister. Reflections move between them even when the rooms themselves are empty, and three walks continue beneath dim arches.

left.message: A polished shard reflects one Berry hidden behind it. Shizuki scratched into the frame: "Still free. Still difficult to catch. Reflection keeps cheating at hide-and-seek."

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache appears in every pane of glass at once. Only one reflection shows the latch open. Following that reflection leads you to the real cache and Star Candies.

forward.message: A Moonglass Hermit sits silently beside the path. Its reflection stands before it does. The actual Hermit follows a second later and advances.

shardlight-walk.prompt: Broken reflections race along a long shardlit hall. Three unmarked doors wait ahead, and each reflection insists you chose a different one.

left.message: You pass what looks like an empty glass panel. Your reflection suddenly ducks. That warning arrives exactly one second before a Moonglass Hermit lunges from the opposite side.

right.message: Shizuki's old camp contains a stoppered bottle beside the note: "A hermit taught me this recipe. I taught him how to pick a lock. Cultural exchange!"
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's cultural-exchange remedy remains stoppered. At full health, you can leave the Hermit's lockpicking lesson in the past.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer has been hidden where several broken mirrors overlap. You follow the only reflection that is smiling and uncover Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Elder Reflection Hall
boss-antechamber.prompt: The final hall contains one enormous mirror without a single crack. Nothing reflects in it—until an ancient shape slowly appears behind you.

bossPromptDiscord:
Your reflection disappears.

Then every mirror in the hall shows the same elderly figure approaching from a different direction.

Only one of them casts a shadow.

Use /yes to face the Elder Reflection or /no to leave before the mirrors decide which version is real.
bossPromptTwitch:
Your reflection disappears.

Then every mirror in the hall shows the same elderly figure approaching from a different direction.

Only one of them casts a shadow.

Use !yes to face the Elder Reflection or !no to leave before the mirrors decide which version is real.
bossRetreatText: You step away from Elder Reflection Hall. The ancient figure recedes from every mirror, though your reflection watches a moment longer.

boss.revealText: The central mirror ripples like water as an ancient shell-clad figure steps through. The Moonglass Elder raises its staff, and every reflection moves with it!

completionText: The Moonglass Elder lowers its guard and returns to the mirror. Your reflection reappears—slightly late, but yours again. As you leave, it gives you a tiny wave you definitely did not make.
